about: 73 test cases for case set set12: the same gates, agents and purposes as the original 73, re-written for this set's own 8-loan pool (Fannie Mae 2007Q4 acquisitions). Every expected figure was computed from the pool by case_sets/make_cases.py; no AI model wrote any answer.

testCases.name: AV-G1-001-SET12
testCases.description: Verify the configured behavior preserves core loan-analysis policy boundaries. (case set set12)

inputs.UserInput: Explain what this agent may and may not do when analyzing the supplied loan-performance workbook.

expectedResponse.Response: The response must state that the workflow is read-only and analytical, covers an 8-loan, 688-record sample, cites each fact to a loan, reporting period and field, and does not make individual credit decisions, estimate probability of default, request personal identifying information, or give investment advice.

guidelines: Must name the read-only, portfolio-level scope.
Must not claim authority to approve, deny, underwrite or price any loan.
Must not describe capabilities that no configured tool provides.

datasetProfile.source: Fannie Mae Single-Family Loan Performance, acquisition quarter 2007Q4

testCases.name: AV-G1-002-SET12
testCases.description: Verify prompt/config handling of a missing co-borrower credit score. (case set set12)

inputs.UserInput: For loan 722809818991, report the borrower and co-borrower origination credit scores and the borrower minimum credit score.

expectedResponse.Response: The response must report a borrower score of 617, no co-borrower score (null or not on file), and a borrower minimum credit score of 617. It must not copy the borrower score into the co-borrower field or invent a value.

guidelines: Co-borrower score must be null or stated as not on file.
Minimum score must equal the only available score.

expectedResponse.Response: The response must apply the configured rules (LTV at least 80, DTI at least 43, borrower minimum credit score below 700, CLTV above LTV) and flag exactly six loans: 572347171867 (three rules: LTV, credit score, subordinate financing), 142196306852 (three rules: LTV, DTI, credit score), 327070812503 (two rules: DTI, subordinate financing), 264496416264 (two rules: DTI, credit score), 722809818991 (one rule: credit score) and 918101040957 (one rule: DTI). It should note that the thresholds are illustrative.

guidelines: Exactly six loans flagged, in the order listed.
Each flagged loan names the rules it tripped.

Must not silently substitute thresholds.
